title: Top 4 Marketing Trends in Portugal in 2024

facts.fact: According to the APPM Marketing Barometer, artificial intelligence is the main marketing trend in Portugal, mentioned by 94% of study participants.
facts.quote: Artificial Intelligence is the main marketing trend in Portugal, mentioned by 94% of participants in the study, reflecting the accelerated adaptation to new technologies.

facts.fact: Portugal Business News states that a 300 x 250 px banner advert appearing on all post pages costs 50 euros per month (vendor's own advertising price).
facts.quote: This banner advert is 300 x 250 px and appears on all post pages. It costs only 50 euros per month!

facts.fact: The Top 4 Marketing Trends in Portugal in 2024 are reported as coming from a new Marketing Barometer published by the Portuguese Association of Marketing Professionals (APPM).
facts.quote: The Top 4 Marketing Trends in Portugal in 2024 are revealed in a new Marketing Barometer published by The Portuguese Association of Marketing Professionals (APPM).

facts.fact: The article was published on September 19, 2024, and is attributed to Valerie Charoux of Portugal Business News.

The APPM barometer lists six main digital marketing strategies currently used in Portugal: social networks, content marketing, traditional advertising, company/agency/freelancer collaborations, SEO, and e-mail marketing.
